scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --workspace=@make-my-marriage/shared && npm run prisma:generate && tsc
scripts.test: npm run db:test:migrate && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env --test test/auth.schema.test.ts test/auth.service.test.ts test/env.test.ts test/event.schema.test.ts test/event.service.test.ts test/password.test.ts test/task.schema.test.ts test/task.service.test.ts test/test-database.test.ts test/tokens.test.ts test/wedding.schema.test.ts test/wedding.service.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env --test test/auth.register.integration.test.ts test/auth.session.integration.test.ts test/auth.verification.integration.test.ts test/event.integration.test.ts test/task.integration.test.ts test/wedding.integration.test.ts
scripts.db:test:migrate: npm run db:test:setup && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma7.test.config.ts
